1.label: very_easy
1.summary: 3 starting reagents; nonperiodic motion span 6.5s; visible circle radius 28px; hot blends last 60s.
1.natural_language:
Study the formula. Open the storm, then merge every pictured pair into the Stormglass heart. Reagents keep drifting while you hold another. Dotted paths show the next 2.5 seconds; solid wakes show the last 0.8 seconds. New blends must form for 5 seconds before reuse; their blue inner ring shows readiness. Hot blends crystallize when their rings empty. Selecting empty space with no reagent held is harmless. You may change your aim before placing or releasing. A missed release, wrong or premature mixture, or crystallized blend ends the episode. Rejected certification also ends the episode. Certify only the complete heart.
